title: Multi-Modal Commute Comparator & Trail Elevation Tracker
name: Multi-Modal Commute Comparator & Trail Elevation Tracker
user_prompt: Create a smart multi-modal route comparator and outdoor cycling/running elevation tracker centered in Denver and Boulder. Let users enter origin and destination points via Places Autocomplete (pre-seeded on load), choose travel modes (Driving, Cycling, Walking, Transit), and toggle route preferences such as Avoid Tolls, Avoid Highways, and Eco-Friendly routing via the Routes API. Render alternative route polylines on the map with comparative travel time and distance cards. Along the active cycling or walking route, query the Elevation API for path samples and plot an interactive elevation-gain and slope profile chart synchronized with a hover marker on the map.
